'''Operation: Blackout''' was a covert [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operation carried out by the agent codenamed [[Cipher Nine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Hunt for the Eagle]]. In the wake of a [[Destruction of the Dominator|terrorist attack]] that claimed the lives of over three thousand people on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] flagship [[Dominator (Harrower-class)|''Dominator'']], Cipher Nine was ordered to infiltrate the [[Balmorran resistance]] and eliminate the cell's leader, [[Gray Star]], who had supplied recruits and training to the [[Eagle's network|terrorist network]] of the [[Eagle]].
